launch_cutline.description: A family publishes at or above the cutline only when every promotion — including break-glass freezes, emergency publications, and out-of-band corrections — is captured as a complete timeline step bound to immutable artifact-graph digests, when release-center and headless flows reconstruct the same history, when an audit/postmortem export can replay it, when each step discloses a reversible window, when its evidence is fresh, when its proof packet is within SLO, and when it is owner-signed; otherwise it narrows below stable.

stop_rules.title: Timeline capture bypassed
stop_rules.rationale: A promotion or emergency action with no complete timeline step narrows the family; emergency flows may not bypass timeline capture.

stop_rules.title: Digest binding missing
stop_rules.rationale: A timeline step that binds no immutable digest narrows the family; promotion history is anchored to immutable graph material.

stop_rules.title: Affected node set incomplete
stop_rules.rationale: A step that cites a digest resolving to no node in the affected set narrows the family.

stop_rules.title: Mutable latest pointer
stop_rules.rationale: A mutable 'latest' pointer may not stand in for immutable graph history.

stop_rules.title: Reconstruction divergent
stop_rules.rationale: Release-center and headless flows must reconstruct the same promotion history.

stop_rules.title: Audit replay unavailable
stop_rules.rationale: An audit/postmortem export must replay who promoted what, when, on which evidence, and with which reversible window.

stop_rules.title: Break-glass unreconciled
stop_rules.rationale: A break-glass action active past its reconciliation window narrows the family.

stop_rules.title: Reversible window undisclosed
stop_rules.rationale: A step that discloses neither a reversible window nor a rollback target narrows the family.

stop_rules.title: Step evidence stale
stop_rules.rationale: A step riding stale or missing blocking evidence narrows the family.

stop_rules.title: Proof packet stale
stop_rules.rationale: A proof packet outside its freshness SLO narrows the family.

stop_rules.title: Proof packet missing
stop_rules.rationale: A family without a captured proof packet narrows below the cutline.

stop_rules.title: Owner sign-off missing
stop_rules.rationale: A family without owner sign-off cannot hold its claimed label.

stop_rules.title: Waiver expired
stop_rules.rationale: A family relying on an expired waiver narrows below the cutline.

rows.rationale: The managed-output family drives publication from a mutable 'latest' pointer, its release-center and headless reconstructions diverge, no audit/postmortem replay is available, a break-glass freeze expired without reconciliation, a step rides stale blocking evidence, and its proof packet breached its SLO; it inherits its below-cutline beta claim and narrows to preview, naming every gap.

publication.rationale: Every release-blocking family at or above the cutline reconstructs the same immutable promotion history across release-center and headless flows, binds every step — ordinary and break-glass — to immutable artifact-graph digests, exposes an audit/postmortem replay, discloses a reversible window, and rides fresh evidence; the managed-output family already inherits a below-cutline claim, so it narrows without blocking the train.
